mechanism: Tenofovir causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and reduces glomerular filtration, impairing torsemide clearance and increasing loop diuretic exposure; combined renal stress increases acute kidney injury risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly; assess volume status closely; consider alternative antiretroviral if possible; adjust torsemide dosing based on renal function changes.
